test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If S % D # F @ G & H @ J, then how is F related to H?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 &
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: S % D # F @ G & H @ J

It means: S is the Wife of D, D is the Brother of F, F is the Daughter of G, G is the Husband of H, H is the Daughter of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a543be662947cb47cefa334ae1af1845589db134b7b6218f91a983be83e22489.png] 

So, F is the 'Daughter' of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
